jobs.prompt: Create a production game background asset extracted/redrawn from these approved UI mockups. 16:9 landscape. Keep their exact warm ivory subtle paper grain, muted peach orchard and humorous Three Kingdoms military camp illustration style, thick dark-brown outlines and forest-green cloth canopy corners. REMOVE EVERY UI element, all panels, cards, icons, character, title, button, numbers, words, labels. Result is ONLY a beautiful background: mostly empty light ivory paper over the central 85% of the image, canvas tents and faint hills at the extreme left and right margins, peach branches at upper corners, a few petals and small stones/grass at bottom edges. No flags with writing, no lettering anywhere, no characters. Decorative art never crosses central empty content space. Low-contrast scenery supports readable dark text later. Full bleed opaque background. This is an asset to sit behind dynamically drawn game controls.

Extract/redraw ONE BLANK reusable paper card panel from this approved game UI. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, centered, fills almost entire image with at most 2% transparent outer margin. Simple rounded rectangular ivory parchment card with thick hand-inked dark brown outline, a fine warm tan inner border parallel to outer edge, subtle papery grain, a short hard shadow offset down/right. The center should be very light near-ivory and COMPLETELY EMPTY. Slightly irregular confident cartoon ink edges. Match the LEFT neutral upgrade card's visual style. NO title plate or top tab; NO icons, no heart, no text, no numerals, no button, no extra objects. Straight edges, not perspective. Transparent outside the single card. Needs to be nine-sliced in a 2D game; keep all decoration entirely inside the outermost 8% border region, center and edges easily stretchable.

Production game UI icon atlas for this exact approved comic UI style: thick dark brown ink outlines, simple chunky 2D cel shading, friendly humorous Three Kingdoms illustrations. Transparent background. EXACTLY FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS, twelve equally sized SQUARE cells, image aspect ratio4:3. Each isolated icon centered with 15% padding inside its cell, equal visual size, no overlaps. NO TEXT, NO NUMERALS, NO labels, no panels, no badges, no gridlines. Reading left-to-right top-to-bottom: 1 red heart wrapped with a tan cloth band (health); 2 clenched tan fist with red wristband (weapon power); 3 small golden impact explosion star with tiny fist silhouette (damage percent); 4 single woven straw sandal with two short speed strokes (attack speed); 5 tiny brown bean-foot shoe with green wing (movement speed); 6 thick wooden green shield with gold rim (armor); 7 red and gold comic sharp starburst (critical chance); 8 wooden circular archery target with one arrow in center (range); 9 small pink peach flower and two green leaves with one tiny green plus (regeneration); 10 small golden coin pouch (pickup); 11 small peach branch surrounded by a pink circular burst of petals (magic area); 12 gold copper coin with square hole (money). Heart, fist and sandal should closely match the large stat illustrations in the reference.

Production transparent game UI title atlas, WIDE LANDSCAPE 2:1 aspect ratio, exactly TWO EQUAL WIDTH HALF PANELS side by side. Copy/redraw ONLY the beautiful bold Chinese titles from these two approved UI references. LEFT HALF: the exact Chinese text '变强了！' in chunky energetic ivory-filled dark-forest-green outlined hand-painted comic brush lettering, with a small vermilion underline swash. RIGHT HALF: exact Chinese text '桃园小铺' in chunky dark forest-green hand-painted rounded brush lettering, tasteful tiny vermilion seal shape without any writing. All glyphs perfectly legible and intact, no other words, numerals or art. Each title horizontally centered in its half with 8% padding, use same approximate visual font height across both. Transparent background everywhere outside letters, no scenery, no paper panel, no character, no frames. NOT a mockup screen, this is a two-cell title sprite sheet.
